name: ablation-freeze-rule-n-maximizing-wording
title: Docs: amend ablation plan S7 freeze rule to N-maximizing baseline (Wilson CI)
description: Codex host-2 review of story B-047f proved the current S7 freeze-rule wording in docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md is wrong: freezing the powered N at the LOWER bound of the pilot Wilson 95% CI is NOT conservative under the pooled two-proportion formula. n(baseline, mde) peaks where the pooled mean (baseline - mde/2) is nearest 0.5, so a Wilson lower bound below 0.5 + mde/2 yields a SMALLER n than the observed baseline (counterexample: pilot 36/60 defects, Wilson lower 0.47366 -> 56/arm, while the observed 0.60 baseline needs 62/arm at mde 0.25). The merged S1 tooling (experiments/experience-ablation/sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck, story B-047f) already implements the corrected rule: freeze at the N-maximizing baseline within the Wilson 95% CI (analytic maximizer p* = 0.5 + mde/2 clamped to the CI). Amend the S7 freeze-rule paragraph, the S13 M6 exit-criteria row, and the S17 step 2 echo to match: freeze the powered N at the N-maximizing baseline within the Wilson 95% CI of the pilot rate (equivalently max over the CI; the lower bound alone is not conservative). Docs-only change; everything else in the doc stays unchanged and entirely English.
